protocol: Fixed candidate-call budgets; no shrinking. Adaptive traces only reference; no-feedback ablation keeps structural/input novelty but removes reference outcome/coverage rewards. Unit tests repeat 6 ordinary cases; boundary is strong fixed edge-case baseline; random samples same families without prioritization; uniform bounded floats; Hypothesis native float lists generate phase only. Synthetic fixtures are not independent real defects; upstream adapters selected by separate research task. No tuning after results.
limitations: Small authored mutation suite, not representative migration success.
Upstream naive candidates are deliberately simple Python semantic models of Rust folds, not full package translations.
No agent-migration aggregate baseline measured; headline repair is a separate case study.
Reference source analysis sees wrapper only for upstream, not vendored dependencies.
Hypothesis may use fewer distinct cases under max_examples; calls recorded.
